title: LLM JSON output fails validation without constrained generation methods
source_title: Show HN: LLMs can generate valid JSON 100% of the time
summary: Show HN post titled 'LLMs can generate valid JSON 100% of the time' linking to the Outlines library; the post presents constraining generation to a target structure as the way to make JSON output valid, instead of relying on the model to follow format instructions.
notes: Attention metrics from the HN Algolia result at collection time.

title: Structured output fails schema validation unless the API enforces the schema
summary: OpenAI announcement of Structured Outputs in its API: responses can be constrained to a supplied JSON Schema so they match the declared format, addressing models that return JSON which fails validation.
notes: Attention metrics from the HN Algolia result at collection time.

title: Structured output from LLMs is treated as a decoding problem, not a prompting one
source_title: Jsonformer: Generate structured output from LLMs
summary: Show HN post for Jsonformer, a 2023 library that generates structured output from LLMs. It is an early decoding-time approach to producing JSON, published before major vendors shipped JSON-schema enforcement.
notes: Attention metrics from the HN Algolia result at collection time.

title: Schema-valid structured output can create false confidence in the values
summary: Blog post arguing that schema-constrained structured output creates false confidence: output that validates against the schema can still be wrong, so schema conformance is not a correctness guarantee.
notes: Attention metrics from the HN Algolia result at collection time.

title: Tool-call argument formats multiply per model into an M×N maintenance burden
source_title: The M×N problem of tool calling and open-source models
summary: Blog post on how tool calling fragments across open-source models: each model and runtime pairing needs its own grammar and parser contract, producing an M×N maintenance problem for tool-call arguments.
notes: Attention metrics from the HN Algolia result at collection time.

title: Guided decoding reformulates generation as finite-state-machine transitions to guarantee structure
source_title: Efficient Guided Generation for Large Language Models
quote: In this article we show how the problem of neural text generation can be constructively reformulated in terms of transitions between the states of a finite-state machine.
summary: Reformulates text generation as transitions between finite-state-machine states, indexing the vocabulary so regex and grammar constraints apply at decode time. The authors present the Outlines implementation as making generated structure guaranteed rather than probable.

title: Constrained decoding guarantees schema compliance but real-world effectiveness was poorly understood
source_title: JSONSchemaBench: A Rigorous Benchmark of Structured Outputs for Language Models
quote: Despite its growing adoption, little has been done with the systematic evaluation of the behaviors and performance of constrained decoding.
summary: Introduces JSONSchemaBench, 10K real-world JSON schemas plus the official JSON Schema Test Suite, to evaluate six constrained-decoding frameworks on efficiency, constraint coverage and output quality, motivated by poor understanding of how well guaranteed schema compliance holds up in practice.

title: Small models struggle to adhere to the required function-call output format
source_title: Small Models, Big Tasks: An Exploratory Empirical Study on Small Language Models for Function Calling
quote: Our findings show that while SLMs improve from zero-shot to few-shot and perform best with fine-tuning, they struggle significantly with adhering to the given output format.
summary: Empirical study of small language models on function calling across domains, with zero-shot, few-shot and fine-tuned settings. The authors report consistent difficulty adhering to the required function-call output format.

title: Constrained decoding can yield locally valid but semantically incorrect structured output
source_title: The Hidden Cost of Structured Generation in LLMs: Draft-Conditioned Constrained Decoding
quote: it can distort generation when the model assigns low probability mass to valid continuations, pushing decoding toward locally valid yet semantically incorrect trajectories.
summary: Argues that token-level constrained decoding for JSON objects and API calls can distort generation when valid continuations have low probability, pushing output toward locally valid but semantically incorrect trajectories; proposes an unconstrained draft before constrained decoding.

title: Schema keys act as an instruction channel and shift structured-output accuracy
source_title: Schema-Key Wording as an Instruction Channel in Structured Generation under Constrained Decoding
quote: changing only schema-key wording can substantially affect accuracy, with both positive and negative effects across models
summary: Systematic study of JSON schema keys as an implicit instruction channel under constrained decoding: changing only schema-key wording substantially changes accuracy on GSM8K and Math500 across seven models, with positive and negative effects.

title: Guided decoding configured for JSON output can still produce improper output
source_title: [Bug]: Guided Decoding (structured json outputs) not generating proper outputs.
summary: vLLM bug report in the structured-output area: guided decoding was configured to produce structured JSON output, but the server did not generate proper outputs, i.e. the constrained-decoding path failed to yield the requested structure.
notes: GitHub issue state=closed at collection time; metrics from unauthenticated search API.

title: JSON-object response mode returns null content on multi-turn requests
source_title: [Bug]: chat.completions returns content: null for GPT-OSS multi-turn with json_object
summary: vLLM bug report: using the json_object response format on multi-turn GPT-OSS requests made chat.completions return content: null instead of the requested JSON object.
notes: GitHub issue state=closed at collection time; metrics from unauthenticated search API.
